# Open Doodles License

Source: https://www.opendoodles.com/about

Open Doodles is published under CC0/public-domain terms by Pablo Stanley.
The source states that the illustrations can be copied, edited, remixed, shared, or redrawn for any purpose without restriction under copyright or database law.

Flow uses Open Doodles as an approved illustration source, not as a component API.
Illustrations must still pass through the Illustration Assets primitive for purpose, alt text, theme, format, fallback, and source metadata.
